settings.description: Configure Powerpal {name}. The pairing code is in the Powerpal phone app under device settings (a decimal number up to 8 digits).

abort.no_devices_found: No Powerpal devices were found on Bluetooth. Make sure a Bluetooth proxy is in range and try again.

init.description: Adjust meter calibration or notification cadence. To change the pairing code, remove and re-add the integration.
